$comment: Every line the town says that is not a place or a person. {x} marks a filled-in word.
title: HARROW GATE
goal: The gate closes at dusk. Find the warden's seal in the archive and get out through the gatehouse before then.

refusal.character: Warden Sela steps into the arch. "Not without the seal, friend. Orders are orders."

win.seal: You show the seal. The warden waves you through, and the west road opens ahead of you.
win.open: Nobody stops you. You walk through the arch and out onto the west road.
win.shortcut: You tie the rope to a merlon and lower yourself down the outside of the wall. Your boots touch the west road.

lose: The bell tolls {hour}. Somewhere west, the gate is barred for the night. You are still inside the walls.
toll: The bell in the chapel tower tolls {hour}.

market.middle: Shutters are coming down along the stalls.
market.late: The stalls are shut and the square is emptying.

dark: It is too dark to read the spines.
deaf: Harrow Gate's square. A dry fountain, a notice board, cobbles worn smooth by carts.
trapdoor: The trapdoor slams shut above you. You push at it; it will not move.
stuck: The trapdoor overhead will not budge. There is no way out.
stuckPlace: The cellar. The trapdoor overhead will not budge. There is no other way out.
locked: The way {dir} is shut. You would need {item}.
riddle: The iron door holds. Words are worked into the bars: "I have a tongue but never speak, and I call the whole town without a word. Name me." Type answer and your word.
riddleRight: The bars draw back with a groan. The stair beyond is open.
riddleWrong: The bars grind and lock tighter. Somewhere below, the town's clock moves on.
noRiddle: There is nothing here waiting for an answer.
nothingThere: You see nothing like that here.
takeDark: It is too dark to find anything. You could light your lamp.
noLamp: You have no lamp to light.
dry: The lamp is dry. There is no oil left.
lit: You light the lamp. Oil left: {oil}.
litArchive: The shelves come out of the dark.
nobody: There is nobody like that here.
noTopic: {name} has nothing to say about that.
buyPoor: You cannot afford it. It costs {price} coins and you have {coin}.
fightNone: There is nothing here to fight.
fightDone: There is nothing left to fight here.
sparWon: Brask grins and lowers his staff. "Fair win."
sparLost: Brask taps your shoulder with the staff. "Yield. Go again when you are ready."
knockedOut: Everything goes dark. You come to on a bench at the inn, hours later.
rest: You rest by the fire. You feel whole again, and an hour slips by.
restPoor: A rest costs a coin, and you have none.
restWhere: There is nowhere to rest here. The inn has beds.
loaded: Game restored to your last save.
noSave: There is no saved game to restore.
help: Verbs: look, go <direction> (or just north, south, east, west, up, down), examine <thing>, take <thing>, talk to <someone>, ask <someone> about <topic>, give <thing> to <someone>, buy <thing>, light lamp, fight <someone>, attack, defend, flee, spar, rest, wait, answer <word>, inventory, status, map, journal, save, load, hint, quit.

hints.key: Someone at the chapel holds the archive key. Try asking about the archive.
hints.dark: The archive is dark. Light your lamp there before you search.
hints.seal: The seal is in the archive, on the desk.
hints.gate: You have the seal. Take it to the gatehouse and go west.
hints.none: Look around and talk to people. The town has more in it than the main road.
